name: Observed Route Reachability
objective: Every route the investigation reached by navigation stays reachable with a non-error status and keeps its stable landmark headings.
description: Regression oracle over observed navigation states.
required_evidence: a route reached by entry or navigation in this run
oracle_requirements: HTTP status observed for the route
headings present in every observation of the route

name: Sortable Collection Ordering
objective: Discover a sortable control, select a supported option, observe the resulting records, and verify the ordering rule the option states.
description: Parameterized over the sort control and the option values actually observed on the target.
required_evidence: a select whose name/id/label denotes sorting
oracle_requirements: ordering key (text or number) and direction derivable from the option label or an explicit requirement

name: Filtered Collection Consistency
objective: Apply an observed filter option and verify every listed record shows the selected value.
description: Parameterized over filter selects observed in GET forms or named as filters.
required_evidence: a filter select with observed option labels
the control that applies the filter
oracle_requirements: records display the filtered attribute as text

name: Field Constraint Boundaries
objective: Apply equivalence partitioning and boundary value analysis to every field whose rule is known from HTML constraints or explicit requirements.
description: Fields with unknown rules are reported as uncertainties, not tested against invented rules.
required_evidence: observed form fields with their declared constraints
oracle_requirements: constraint source: HTML attribute, explicit requirement, or observed validation message
safety_constraints: form submissions only on authorized hosts within the mutation budget

name: Created Record Reflection
objective: Submit a create/save form with valid data and verify the entered identifying value is shown afterwards.
description: Uses only the observed create form and its fields; the expected text is the test's own input.
required_evidence: a POST form whose action or submit control denotes creation
oracle_requirements: the identifying text field value entered by the test
safety_constraints: creates one record; local/authorized hosts only
